name: What is sewer line excavation?

acceptedAnswer.text: Sewer line excavation involves digging into the ground to access and repair or replace underground sewer pipes. This process is typically necessary when non-invasive methods like trenchless repair aren't feasible due to severe damage, pipe collapse, or complex access issues. Understanding the extent of the damage, often through a camera inspection, is a crucial first step in determining if excavation is the most appropriate solution for your property.
acceptedAnswer.description: Sewer line excavation is the process of digging up ground to access and repair or replace underground sewer pipes, usually when other repair methods are not possible.
